query: WITH prior AS ( SELECT resolved, outcome FROM merge_candidates WHERE series_id = LEAST($2::uuid, $3::uuid) AND candidate_id = GREATEST($2::uuid, $3::uuid) ), upsert AS ( INSERT INTO merge_candidates (id, series_id, candidate_id, score, signals, reason) VALUES ($1, LEAST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), GREATEST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (series_id, candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, signals = EXCLUDED.signals, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, resolved = false, outcome = NULL, resolved_by = NULL, resolved_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE NOT merge_candidates.resolved OR merge_candidates.outcome = 'distinct' RETURNING 1 AS touched ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prior) THEN 'added' WHEN (SELECT NOT resolved FROM prior) THEN 'refreshed' WHEN (SELECT outcome FROM prior) = 'distinct' THEN 'reopened' ELSE 'unchanged' END AS "outcome!"
